text:
maria: Quick sync — drafting a lightweight follow-up cadence for postmortems. Goal: ensure action items don't linger. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

jon: love this. can we try a '3-stage' timeline? immediate(24h) / short(7d) / medium(30d)

alex: +1. propose owners get a weekly auto-reminder until status=closed. low noise tho.

lia: also think we should require a single 'remediation owner' field and a fallback owner if overdue by 14d.

maria: agreed. rough template I'm thinking:
- 24h: ACK, assign owner, set ETA
- 7d: triage update + small win check
- 30d: remediation plan or escalated rollback
- 90d: follow-up eval for recurrence

sam: can we put this in a checklist template? something we can paste into the PM doc.

maria: yes — I sketched one:
```
[ ] Owner: <github handle>
[ ] 24h: ack + short note
[ ] 7d: triage note + blocker list
[ ] 30d: remediation plan link
[ ] 90d: recurrence eval
```

jon: who owns running the weekly 'closure hour' (30-minute slot) where owners can drop-in and triage items?

maria: propose rotating facilitation: ops-eng does week 1, infra week 2, runtime week 3. incident-commander on rotation takes minutes.

alex: session should be recorded + notes appended to postmortem doc. also add a 'priority' tag (p0/p1) to help sorting.

lia: about IC rotation — make it 2-week stints so handoffs are fewer. document handoff checklist: current incidents, open remediations, upcoming closure hour slots.

sre-bot: reminder: auto-reminders can be implemented via /remind or our remediation-tracker. I can post weekly digest if enabled.

maria: action items from this thread:
- maria: create checklist template + PR to docs by Thu
- jon: prototype slack reminders using sre-bot by next Tue
- alex: add priority tags + filter to remediation board by next Fri
- lia: draft IC handoff checklist by Mon

sam: +1 on deadlines. can we add a simple SLA: owners update at least once per 7 days until closed?

maria: yep — SLA: update cadence >= weekly. I'll add to template.

jon: one more ask — telemetry: add a 'stuck' label when an item hasn't changed in 21 days; triggers escalation.

maria: good call. lia, can you and alex decide escalation path for 'stuck' items?

lia: will do. thanks all — I'll jump on the doc tonight and tag people.

alex: thanks — :thumbsup:

maria: ping if you want to pair on wording. posting this to #eng-docs after we tidy.

sre-bot: Scheduled reminder created: weekly remediation digest -> #eng-oncall every Monday at 10:00.
